witness.witnessDiscipline: single_witness_candidate_only — establishes discovery, not freeze truth

discoverySummary: FlexWash integration-level behaviors cluster into three distinguishable functional responsibilities: (1) inter-subsystem communication between upper and lower control domains (AC7), (2) system-level supervisory fault surfacing (SF), and (3) dual-compartment cycle coordination including independent compartment operation and cross-compartment dependencies. Multi-instance front_load_washer composition (FL_LOWER + FL_UPPER) plus shared power/HMI can represent compartment-local wash functions without distorting the frozen FL graph, but cannot represent inter-instance communication, system supervisory faults, or cross-compartment coordination using only existing front_load_washer relationships on a single instance. Existing relationship types (communicates_with, depends_on, commands, enables, inhibits) are sufficient at the type level, but require a composition host and at least one integration functional domain to anchor cross-instance edges — analogous to AIO integrated_laundry_orchestration, without copying its wash/dry semantics. Dual-column fault attribution is primarily multi-instance scoping (metadata), not a separate canonical function, though it depends on instance identity being explicit in the composition model. Discovery leans toward ONE minimal integration abstraction with multiple responsibilities rather than several unrelated blobs, but corroboration is required before freeze. No abstraction name is authorized for promotion.

ac7Analysis.functionalBehavior: Diagnostic detection and remediation of failed bidirectional signaling between the upper washer sub PBA and the lower main PBA over the CN803 interconnect harness (TX_OWM/RX_OWM plus power lines). OEM states signals between upper and lower main PBAs are not sensed due to communication error.

physicalVsFunctional.physical: CN803 harness, connector integrity, TX_OWM/RX_OWM lines
physicalVsFunctional.functional: Inter-subsystem control-domain communication required for coordinated dual-load operation; AC7 is a functional communication failure code, not a wire-only test

existingRelationshipSufficiency.rationale: front_load_washer.communicates_with links components within one washer graph (e.g. hmi_control↔control_board, motor_controller↔control_board). AC7 is between two distinct control domains belonging to different composed instances. Without a composition layer and qualified endpoints, communicates_with has no valid from/to anchors.

faultPartitionAnalysis.functionalBehavior: OEM fault table presents Upper and Lower columns; many codes appear in both columns (1C/1C, 3C/3C, 5C/5C) while some are asymmetric (HC lower vs HC1 upper, 4C2 upper-only in column layout).
